About Advance Machinery Movers

Incorporated in 1997 in Johor Bahru. 29 years in operation, and our 30th anniversary in 2027.

WhatsApp usCall the office

A Johor Bahru company since 1997

Advance Machinery Movers Sdn. Bhd. (441099-U) was incorporated in 1997 in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. We are a service provider in the moving and packing industry in Malaysia and Singapore.

Our customer base includes MNCs and SMEs. 2026 is our 29th year in operation, and we reach our 30th anniversary in 2027.

29 Years in Operation · Approaching 30 Years in 2027Company no. 441099-UTampoi Jaya, Johor Bahru

Trained crews, insured moves

  • Training

    Our personnel are fully trained in forklift operations and safety issues by UMW and CIDB. Regular in-house and on-site training is carried out.

  • Licences

    Our staff have the required licences.

  • Goods-in-transit insurance

    We have insurance coverage for goods in transit.

  • Personal Accident insurance

    Our personnel are covered by Personal Accident (PA) insurance.
